author: Ankit
problem: Read an H by W grid of lowercase letters. Print Yes if there is a path from the top-left to the bottom-right cell, moving between side-adjacent cells, whose letters read s, n, u, k, e, s, n, u, k, e, ... in order; otherwise print No.
bug_description: The final check tests grid[h][w] (a letter, always truthy) instead of the visited flag bool[h][w], so any grid starting with 's' gets Yes.

comments.accurate: Searches from the top-left following s-n-u-k-e in a cycle and checks whether the bottom-right is reached
comments.wrong_behavior: The search marks the reachable cells; any maze whose start cell is 's' is accepted
comments.wrong_location: Final reachability check verified; check that the letter map wraps from e back to s
